items.evidence: Acceptance test passes in both browsers (949ms chromium, 1.2s webkit). Root cause reproduced independently: waitForFunction with an async predicate on a never-present selector resolved with false after 9ms (chromium) / 11ms (webkit) - it does not poll. With the base-commit openCardGallery temporarily restored, the late-render test fails in both browsers with count 0 vs expected 1; restored via git checkout HEAD (diff empty afterwards). Holdout: 1500ms-delayed real bundle -> after open, 1 logo, decodes 512x512, 105 card svgs present, both browsers; 10 consecutive immediate opens each find exactly 1 logo; a gallery that never renders rejects with TimeoutError from locator.waitFor; two logos reject with a strict mode violation; a 512x512 single-logo stub resolves.

Acceptance test passes in both browsers. Mutation check: an opener that skips the decode/size step makes this test fail in both browsers, so the test can fail. (The old async-predicate opener also rejected this case, since the decode rejection propagated; SPEC-02 is a guard, not a reproduction.) Holdout: undecodable logo rejects in ~20ms with EncodingError (not a timeout) in both browsers; missing href rejects; a 64x32 image rejects with 'card-back logo decoded at 64x32, expected 512x512'.

Acceptance test passes in both browsers. Diff confirms toHaveCount(1) before mutating, mutation via locator.evaluate (no ?.), toHaveAttribute(name, value) after, unchanged mutants and logoProblems expectation. Mutation checks (temporary, restored exactly): (a) making the locator mutation a no-op -> test fails at toHaveAttribute (Expected "0", Received "") in both browsers; (b) an opener that returns before the gallery renders -> test fails at toHaveCount (Expected 1, Received 0) instead of the old misleading ['missing'] list.
